verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim ships official Python namespace packages installable via pip, supports Python-first workflows, and documents standalone scripts for controlling robots and environments, so there is a genuine first-party Python SDK. Nothing in the evidence shows official SDKs in TypeScript, Go or C++. Typing and full-surface coverage are not demonstrated either; the ROS 2 services and actions are an integration interface, not a language SDK. missing for 10: official TypeScript, Go and C++ SDKs, evidence of typed bindings, evidence that the SDKs cover the full platform surface, independent corroboration.
